tvShow.name: Memory of a Killer
tvShow.overview: Angelo Doyle lives two totally separate lives — fearsome NYC hitman and sleepy upstate Cooperstown photocopier salesman and father. Both of them are threatened when he is diagnosed with Alzheimer's, a disease he already lost his older brother to.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: After carrying out a hit on his latest assigned target, Angelo begins to realize his mind may be failing him as his two, completely separate lives are slowly crashing together.

episodes.name: Ferryman
episodes.overview: After the hit on his daughter, Angelo warns Maria about her mom's killer. FBI Agent Grant questions him, while Angelo and Joe handle a mob accountant.

episodes.name: Samurai
episodes.overview: Dutch assigns Angelo to kill an Internal Affairs Agent who threatens to take down their whole operation. Still rattled by the shooting, Maria seeks Dave's help in procuring a gun. Agent Grant runs into Angelo, who suspects she may see him as more than just the father of a victim.

episodes.name: Unhappy Ending
episodes.overview: Angelo postpones a hit to hunt for The Ferryman, who he believes was responsible for the hit on Maria. Meanwhile, the FBI investigates a crime scene linked to Angelo.

episodes.name: Betrayal
episodes.overview: While on a hit Angelo remembers a pivotal moment in his life, 5 years ago, when he learned his brother had Alzheimer's and Angelo was forced to make a life-changing decision.

episodes.name: Uncle Jacob
episodes.overview: Haunted by fractured memories, Angelo questions his perception of reality. Joe helps Angelo plan a high-tech public assassination of a Russian mob accountant who is about to testify on live TV. Detective Woods investigates one of Angelo's murders, bringing him one step closer to uncovering Angelo's secret life.

episodes.name: Dr. Parks
episodes.overview: Angelo learns that a previous job may be the key to unmasking The Ferryman. Meanwhile, Dave has a big break in his investigation that could expose Angelo's true identity.

episodes.name: Tailored by Fabroni
episodes.overview: Major revelations threaten to upend Angelo's family. Joe gets the opportunity of a lifetime.

episodes.name: Shoot the Piano Player
episodes.overview: After a stunning reveal, Angelo races against the clock to protect the ones he loves from The Ferryman's path of death and destruction.

episodes.name: Exposed
episodes.overview: Angelo's worlds collide, setting up an explosive and heart-racing confrontation with The Ferryman.
